objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has the ability to modify Group Policy on victim Domain Controllers through a PowerShell script that enables simultaneous ransomware detonation on every computer in domain.(Citation: TrendAI_TheGentlemen_Sept2025)(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
